name: 36507-longdecode-mimo7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, speculative TP=1; one in-process vLLM engine on one GPU.
architecture: Dense decoder (MiMoForCausalLM), 36 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 11008, vocab 151680, rope_theta 640000, bf16, 7.83B params; plus one in-checkpoint MTP layer (`num_nextn_predict_layers: 1`, ~0.21B). All read off the published config.json and safetensors index.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams = 1, bounded at 80 requests / 3600 s safety cap. The 10% warmup discards 8 requests and the declared 10% cooldown never opens, so 72 requests are scored; `duration`, `RPS` and `request_concurrency` read the safety cap by construction rather than the run, so do not quote them.
workload: guidellm `json_file`, single turn, no prefix bucket: `configs/data/spec-bench-turn1.jsonl`. All 480 questions of Spec-Bench (https://github.com/hemingkx/Spec-Bench) reduced to their first turn, ordered as vLLM's own SpecBench loader orders them (shuffled at seed 0); the 80 rows this bound consumes are raw mean 292.1 / min 9 / p50 57 / max 1397 tokens, +19 each once the ChatML template is applied. Output is fixed at exactly 1024 tokens per request (max_tokens=1024, ignore_eos), greedy at temperature 0.0.
purpose: A seven-billion-parameter reasoning assistant answering one request at a time with long thousand-token replies on a single GPU.
launch:
# Engine: vLLM at commit 4ff9b045fe7a9da9b5a7737407ed4e7ef203ffad (v0.17.0rc0-193-g4ff9b045fe7a9).
# Interpreter and hardware for this machine: configs/env.yaml (not portable).

model: XiaomiMiMo/MiMo-7B-RL

# Required, not a preference: `model_type: mimo` is in neither transformers 4.57.6 nor vLLM's
# `_CONFIG_REGISTRY`, so the config class can only be resolved from the repository.
trust-remote-code: true

# HAZARD: this value must stay on ONE line as inline JSON. Re-flowed to a block mapping the key
# is dropped and the engine starts with no drafter, at rc=0.
speculative-config: {"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 5, "draft_tensor_parallel_size": 1}

# Not binding (longest request is 1416 rendered prompt + 1024 output); pinned so the KV pool is
# a fixed size and no request is chunked.
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-batched-tokens: 4096

tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 4
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9

# Off, against the V1 default of on: with caching on, how much prefill a request performs would
# depend on what ran before it.
enable-prefix-caching: false

dtype: bfloat16
